title: Create repeatable MAP practice-scenario runbook and queue
description: Create planning-only groundwork for recurring, operator-visible MAP practice scenarios with Claude. Define a repeatable lifecycle exercise, bounded roles, evidence packet, measures, stop rules, independent review, tuning loop, and a prioritized scenario queue. Preserve normal task/approval authority; do not edit TASK-227 implementation plan, agent permissions, startup policy, or runtime services.
acceptance_criteria: The runbook defines a reusable scenario packet, role boundaries, lifecycle stages, explicit operator decision points, evidence locations, stop conditions, and independent-review requirement without creating a new authority path.

The scorecard measures first-valid-action correctness, time/order, retrieval paths, handoff/fallback friction, operator attention burden, review/release outcome, interruption/recovery, and a negative-result rule.
The queue names at least three bounded next scenarios derived from KICK-01/current MAP constraints, each with hypothesis, minimum evidence, non-goals, and an admission gate.
The work records how a completed run becomes either a narrowly scoped task/decision candidate or a preserved negative result; it does not auto-promote findings.
